note: The raw hex input string is parsed into an H3Index verbatim with no validation; index digits may therefore hold the invalid value 7 (INVALID_DIGIT).
Base cell (0 for the crafted index) passes the 0..NUM_BASE_CELLS bounds check, so execution reaches the digit-adjustment loop.
For the crafted index res=1, the loop starts at r=0 and immediately examines the resolution-1 index digit.
The 3-bit digit (0-7) is extracted but never validated to be < NUM_DIGITS (7) before being used as a row index into the translation tables; crafted digit is 7.
res=1 is a class III resolution, so the NEW_DIGIT_III / NEW_ADJUSTMENT_III constant tables are selected for the digit adjustment.
oldDigit=7 indexes row 7 of the 7x7 constant direction table NEW_DIGIT_III, an out-of-bounds read past the end of the table.
